description: Call this when the user asks whether now is a historically better or worse time to buy bitcoin, or wants Galaxy Mind's Buying Gauge. Returns a 0-100 score (higher = historically better entry) from 10 weighted signals, the tier, each signal, and the best upcoming entry window. The gauge is Galaxy Mind's composite opinion, not a market fact or investment advice. If degraded=true, treat the score as best-effort, not a live reading. Methodology: https://galaxymind.space/methodology
name: get_buying_gauge
